people.name: Darius
people.line: Persian king who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple

people.name: Zechariah
people.line: Post-exilic prophet who wrote the book of Zechariah

translations.web: In the fourth year of king Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
translations.bsb: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of Jehovah came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chislev.
